android.desc:
Bitacora is the best app for quickly and easily inserting data into a PostgreSQL database.

🔹 Main features:

Convenient data insertion.
Edit or delete the last inserted row.
Connect to your PostgreSQL database in seconds.
⚡ Why use Bitacora?
Because it gives you full control over your data without relying on third-party apps. Use PostgreSQL as your own backend for journaling, weight tracking, habit tracking, or anything else.

💡 Try the beta version and help improve it!
This is the first open testing version. Your feedback is welcome!

Let me know if you need any adjustments! 🚀

quotes.text:
I'm working on an Android/iOS database client to quickly insert data (currently supporting Postgres). I use it to record my workouts, journal, etc.

It's in open testing phase for Android users if anyone wants to check it out: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.manugo.bitacora
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (February 2025)
